title: Equal subset sums and close divisors
summary: For $k\geq2$, let $α_k$ be the supremum of the exponents $a$ for which almost every integer $n$ has $k$ distinct divisors in a multiplicative interval of relative length $(\log n)^{-a}$. Select each positive integer $i$ independently with probability $1/i$, forming a random set $\mathbf A$, and let $β_k$ be the supremum of the $c<1$ for which, with probability tending to one as $D\to\infty$, the set $\mathbf A\cap[D^c,D]$ has $k$ distinct subsets with the same sum. We prove that $α_k=β_k/(1-β_k)$, resolving a conjecture of Ford, Green and Koukoulopoulos [Invent. Math. 232 (2023),…
